description: Defines a UsersModel with CRUD operations and authentication helpers for user data, interacting with 'users' and 'users_auth' database tables.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with name and email.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: getByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email (public safe fields).

methods.name: getByEmailInternal
methods.description: Retrieves a full user record by email (internal use).

methods.name: setPasswordHash
methods.description: Sets or updates the password hash for a user in 'users_auth' table.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Retrieves the password hash for a user by user ID.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists users with optional pagination and search query.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user information such as name and email.
